name: requires-ruling-13-requires-value-outside-the-when-is-unreachable
reference: spec 0.30 ruling 13: `requires <k>` and `requires <k>=<values>` on a kind with `when ... as <k>` load; every term must hold; a `requires <k>=` value outside the `when` makes the kind unreachable: never requires x=20 and its `when` is 1..9; any takes x = 20 (14)
